The Toyota bZ family

2 generations and variants in the Index, 2023–present. Oldest first; every card opens the full page, with its own versions, figures and story.

  1. 2023–present

    Toyota bZ4X / bZ

    Toyota's first mass-market electric SUV in the US, about the size of a RAV4. The 2023–2025 bZ4X has up to 252 miles of EPA range; the 2026 bZ brought bigger batteries, a NACS port, 338 hp with AWD and up to 314 miles.

    214 hp6.3 sec 0-6074,857 built
  2. 2026–present

    Toyota bZ Woodland

    A longer, more rugged sibling of the 2026 bZ, with 375 hp, all-wheel drive, 8.4 inches of ground clearance and up to 74.3 cubic feet of cargo space. The EPA range is up to 281 miles, or 260 with the optional all-terrain tires.

    375 hp3.9 sec 0-60
